title: mcxanon run report (format 6)
description: Contains no original values, no secret, no absolute paths and no wall-clock time. Format 2 adds the sip object and the sip_ruleset (feature 002); format 3 adds the media object and the media_ruleset (feature 004); format 4 adds the xml object and the xml_ruleset (feature 003). Format 5 (feature 005): options.encrypted, the mikey_ruleset and mikey objects, scan.warnings and the MIKEY statements. Format 6 (feature 007): the http_ruleset, http, tls_ruleset and tls objects and the web statements.

output.description: base name only; null when not published

counters.description: Keyed by FieldId; each value counts decisions by action (l7: handed to the SIP layer).

sdp.description: key: SDP line type (o=, c=, ...) or attribute (a=rtcp, a=fmtp:MCPTT, ...)

bodies.description: key: Content-Type of a known rule

label.description: pseudonym, removed:<cat>#n, input:<cat>#n or deny#<line>; never an original

unscannable_by_category.description: key: <category>/<reason>, reason = short or vocabulary, or degenerate (one repeated octet, feature 005)

warnings.description: passthrough only (feature 005, FR-018): hits wholly inside a passthrough element

not_anonymised.description: Fixed statements, e.g. packet sizes, timing, ordering, ports unless pseudonymised, VLAN IDs unless pseudonymised.

media_ruleset.description: The embedded media rule set: RTP, RTCP, MCX RTCP APP and MSRP (feature 004).

media.description: The media layer's counts (feature 004). Keys are packet types, APP names and subtypes, rule names, pseudonymised SSRCs or fixed reason words, never input values.

xml_ruleset.description: The embedded XML rule set: MCX XML bodies (feature 003).

xml.description: The XML layer (feature 003). Names without rules pass the report-name check.

bodies.description: key: Content-Type of an XML document rule

namespaces.description: key: a namespace name without rules, after the report-name check

http.description: HTTP in the clear (feature 007): counts only; map keys are protocol vocabulary or "(invalid)".
